hero.headline: End-to-End AI Film Production, Engineered for Scale.
hero.subheadline: The industry-grade platform for professional content creators. Offering AI-powered tools for screenwriting, scene generation, cinematic rendering, and complete production management.

videos.title: 1. Generate Scripts
videos.description: Collaborate with the AI agent to write compelling, structural narratives.

videos.title: 2. Render Scenes
videos.description: AI-powered cinematic rendering directly from your script elements.

videos.title: 3. Assemble Video
videos.description: Automated assembly, transitions, voiceovers, and final rendering.

journey.title: From Idea to Final Cut
journey.subtitle: A seamless six-step production pipeline that takes you from a blank canvas to a polished film — with AI handling the heavy lifting at every stage.

steps.label: Create Project
steps.description: Set up your film project with a name, duration, and creative brief.

steps.label: Script Generation
steps.description: The Script Agent structures your prompt into a shot-by-shot narrative plan.

steps.label: Character Design
steps.description: The Character Agent generates consistent visual characters from your script.

steps.label: Voiceover & Dialogue
steps.description: The Voiceover Agent produces dialogue audio for each character.

steps.label: Shot-by-Shot Rendering
steps.description: The Video Agent renders each scene with full cinematic quality.

steps.label: Final Assembly
steps.description: The Editor Agent stitches approved clips into a complete film.

agents.title: Five Specialized AI Agents, One Unified Pipeline
agents.subtitle: Each agent is purpose-built for a single production stage. They pass approved artifacts downstream in a deterministic chain — no ambiguity, no lost context.

list.name: Script Agent
list.description: Interprets your creative brief, identifies story elements and characters, structures the narrative into generation-ready shots, and allocates dialogue and visual descriptions according to the target duration.
details: Parses user prompt and reference materials
Structures story into scenes and individual shots
Allocates dialogue per character per shot
Respects target duration and provider constraints
Outputs a versioned, reviewable script artifact
list.approval: You review the full script. Approve to proceed, or request revisions with specific feedback. Only the approved version flows to the next agent.

list.name: Character Agent
list.description: Extracts all characters from the approved script, allows you to configure appearance references, and generates consistent character visuals that maintain identity across every scene.
details: Extracts character list from approved script
Accepts user-provided reference images
Generates consistent character appearances
Ensures visual continuity across all scenes
Supports targeted regeneration of individual characters
list.approval: Review each character individually. Reject and regenerate specific characters without losing approved ones.

list.name: Voiceover Agent
list.description: Configures unique voice profiles for each character, processes the dialogue from the approved script, and generates high-quality audio segments that match the timing and emotion of each scene.
details: Assigns unique voice profiles per character
Processes dialogue text from approved script
Generates audio segments per shot
Supports preview, re-recording, and fine-tuning
Batch or per-segment review workflow
list.approval: Preview audio segments individually. Approve the full batch or regenerate specific dialogue lines.

list.name: Video Agent
list.description: Renders individual video shots using the full approved context — script, characters, and audio. Runs parallel generation jobs tracked via Redis queues, with per-shot review and targeted regeneration.
details: Consumes all upstream approved artifacts
Parallel shot generation via Redis job queues
Real-time job status tracking and progress
Handles background music where supported
Per-shot review with targeted regeneration
list.approval: Review each shot individually. Approve, reject, or regenerate specific shots while keeping others intact.

list.name: Editor Agent
list.description: Assembles all approved video shots, applies transitions between scenes, overlays the approved voiceover audio, and produces the final rendered film ready for export.
details: Assembles approved clips in narrative order
Applies scene transitions automatically
Overlays voiceover and background audio
Produces final rendered video output
Confirmation step before final assembly
list.approval: Confirm the final assembly. This is a compilation step, not a creative rewrite stage.

projectManager.title: Your Creative Command Center
projectManager.subtitle: Every asset, every version, every decision — organized and accessible in one persistent workspace.

features.title: Project Folders
features.description: Create, rename, and manage separate film projects. Each project maintains its own isolated assets, conversations, and workflow state.

features.title: Version Control
features.description: Every script revision, character iteration, and video re-render is tracked. Compare versions side-by-side and roll back to any prior state.

features.title: Artifact Browser
features.description: Browse scripts, character sheets, voiceover clips, video shots, and the final film — all organized by production stage within your project.

features.title: Review & Approval
features.description: Approve, reject, or request changes at every stage. Only approved artifacts flow downstream. You maintain complete creative authority.

features.title: Session Persistence
features.description: Close your browser mid-render and come back tomorrow. Your workflow state, pending approvals, and running jobs are all preserved.

features.title: Multi-Tab Workspace
features.description: Open multiple artifacts simultaneously. Review your script in one tab while inspecting generated characters in another.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Scale when you're ready.
